svg.title: Deal4Me: from a sentence to a settled rental
svg.desc: A loop of eight numbered stations that a red token travels around, each station lighting up as the token arrives. Seller stations are dark, buyer stations are blue and the negotiation station is red. 1, Describe: speak, snap up to 12 photos, or paste a website. 2, AI builds the store: Claude reads it, prices it and picks the photos, producing items, prices and deposits. 3, Go live: one tap gives a QR code and a public link, /s/your-shop. The seller sets up stations 1 to 3 once. 4, Ask in any language: the buyer types or speaks, for example skis for 3 days under $150, or the same in Japanese. 5, Negotiate: two private Claude Haiku agents haggle while rules.ts holds the line; the owner counters $35, $33, $32, $31 and the deal lands at $30 a day. 6, Approve and hold: you approve every booking; $370 is held, not charged. 7, Pick up and return: a pickup code and photos, then an AI damage check compares the photos. 8, Settle: $90 charged, $280 released, and the owner's earnings tick up. A return lane labelled the next buyer finds it leads from Settle back to station 4, closing the loop.

g.font-family: 'Public Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: From a sentence to a settled rental
AI builds the store and negotiates the deal; people make the calls.
the seller sets this up once
